name: Abdrahman Abubakar
headline:
Full-stack developer and engineer

intro: A full-stack developer building fast, reliable web applications, from the interface to the database.
about:
I'm a full-stack developer and engineer who builds web applications end to end. On the frontend, I work with HTML5, CSS, Javascript, React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS to create interfaces that are fast, accessible and easy to use. On the backend, I build APIs, design PostgreSQL databases, MYSQL and PHP, and set up authentication, so the whole product holds together.

I learn by shipping. Right now I'm building one project a day for 30 days, moving from React fundamentals to full-stack apps with AI features.

I'm looking for teams and projects where I can contribute from day one, take on unfamiliar problems and keep growing as an engineer.
